The tell was TokenJaccard and TokenOverlap returning byte-identical numbers despite differing only in similarity().

superseded.reason: Measured against the WRONG CORPUS. `params.corpus_revision` is 0c8487a80bed — terpsi-music's PR #7 head — not the pinned 6ea9b89 every other recorded stage-3 figure uses. PR #7 deleted docs/SKINS.md and docs/prose.intent, so the gate rejected 16 spans as 'source_file does not exist' and this run measured 86 spans over 10 referents instead of 96 over 14. The probe counts give it away: n=[4, 10, 14, 36] against the correct [4, 12, 14, 41]. The corpus_revision field recorded the mistake correctly and was not read; the run was checked with `| tail -2`, which truncated away the gate's rejection counts. A pinned-revision banner now prints as the LAST line.
